name: W Taipei
insider_take: W Taipei pulses with electric energy in the heart of Taiwan's capital, where cutting-edge design meets the vibrant spirit of Asia's most dynamic night scene.
whats_special: This ultra-modern tower sits in Xinyi District, Taipei's Times Square equivalent, with direct underground access to Taipei 101 and some of Asia's best shopping. The hotel's signature YEN Bar on the 10th floor offers craft cocktails with panoramic city views, while the Living Room lobby transforms into a pulsating social hub after dark. The property features Taiwan's first W Hotels brand experience with locally-inspired design elements throughout.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 20+ for unobstructed views of Taipei 101's nightly light show, and time your arrival for sunset at YEN Bar when the city lights begin to twinkle.
dont_miss: The hotel's strategic location puts you steps from Elephant Mountain hiking trail for Instagram-worthy Taipei 101 shots, the bustling Raohe Street Night Market for authentic street food, and the upscale Breeze shopping centers. The nearby Four Four South Village offers a glimpse into Taiwan's military dependents' village culture with trendy cafes and weekend markets.
pros: Prime location in Xinyi District near Taipei 101 and major shopping
Vibrant modern design with signature W Hotels contemporary style
Exceptional rooftop bar and dining venues with city skyline views
High-tech amenities and innovative room features
cons: Trendy atmosphere may not suit traditional luxury preferences
